name: Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (EUR)
oneLiner: EURSAFO is Spiko's EUR share of the Spiko/Amundi Smart Cash fund, a UCITS overnight-swap money-market vehicle authorized by the AMF.
collateral: EUR share class of the Spiko / Amundi Smart Cash fund using fully collateralized total-return swaps with tier-1 bank counterparties and collateral made of liquid financial instruments / money-market fund exposure.
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting share class; subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated through Spiko fund-transfer rails at the published fund NAV.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: EURSAFO is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: EURSAFO is the EUR share class of Spiko's AMF-authorized UCITS fund; tokens are minted to KYC'd investor addresses by Spiko's in-house 'daily-operator' relayer and burned by a dedicated redemption contract, under a multisig super-admin that can upgrade contracts and manage permissions.

controls.label: Spiko daily-operator relayer (minter)
controls.evidence: Spiko's published contract design assigns an in-house 'daily-operator' relayer responsibility for minting tokens to investor addresses and handling redemptions; minting is gated to investors who pass KYC and join permission groups.

controls.label: Spiko super-admin multisig
controls.evidence: A multisig 'super-admin' permission group holds full access to upgrade the UUPS-proxy contracts and manage permission groups (including the minter/burner roles); exact signer set and threshold not independently confirmed on-chain.

review.evidence: Spiko's smart-contract post describes a permission-group RBAC: an in-house daily-operator relayer mints to KYC'd investors, a redemption contract holds the sole burn role, and a super-admin multisig controls UUPS upgrades and permissions. This is centralized issuer-direct minting, not a user-collateralized path.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Roles and minter design taken from Spiko's first-party contract documentation; live on-chain super-admin multisig signers/threshold and the relayer address were not independently read on-chain, so confidence is probable rather than verified.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain super-admin multisig signers/threshold and the daily-operator relayer address for the EURSAFO deployments to reach verified.

reserves.name: Fully collateralized overnight total-return swap exposure
